findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: propose_briefs, get_citations · Private data: get_company_facts, check_aeo_record, generate_fixes, run_audit, generate_free_record · Public sink: propose_briefs · Destructive: propose_briefs, generate_fixes, get_citations, run_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: propose_briefs, get_citations · Private data: get_company_facts, check_aeo_record, generate_fixes, run_audit, generate_free_record · Public sink: propose_briefs · Destructive: propose_briefs, generate_fixes, get_citations, run_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
